statements.t: Building on our refined market development framework, we hosted several successful community pool events in targeted Florida neighborhoods, with additional events planned in Florida and Texas before year-end.
There is one Latham pool already installed in a model home, and we look forward to expanding this relationship further.

In parallel, we continued to strengthen our sales capabilities, adding field sales resources in Florida, with further expansion planned in Texas and Arizona, while targeted marketing initiatives are gaining traction and contributing to growth.

These initiatives position Latham to drive meaningful growth regardless of the pace of market recovery, and we are confident that Latham will continue to outperform the U.S. in-ground pool market in 2027 and beyond.
Reflecting that confidence, our Board of Directors recently approved a three-year $100 million stock repurchase plan that underscores our positive long-term outlook.

“With much of the pool building season now behind us, and based on our current visibility through year-end, we are narrowing our net sales guidance range to $605-615 million and our adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $112-118 million.
